study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Candidemia, mixed-age cohort (includes pediatric patients per Table 2). TTP-mortality analysis is unadjusted (chi-square only); no multivariable model linking TTP to mortality. 6-week mortality endpoint.

population.pathogen_species: Candida spp. (C. parapsilosis 27%, C. tropicalis 27%, C. albicans 21%, C. glabrata 8%, Trichosporon 4%, C. krusei 3%, others)
population.empiric_abx_definition: Appropriate antifungal therapy started within 24h of candidemia onset (84/100)
population.incubation_protocol: BacT/ALERT 3D Microbial Detection System, standard incubation
population.notes: Median age survivors 63 (IQR 47-70), died 66 (IQR 55-77). Mixed age including some pediatric (5 patients 0-1 month, 4 patients >1-12 months, 4 patients >1-16 yrs).

ttp.notes: Overall median TTP 34h (IQR 21.75-50). Species-specific medians: C. albicans 42h (34-57), C. tropicalis 20.5h (19-23.5), C. parapsilosis 45h (34-58), C. glabrata 70.5h (60.5-73), C. krusei 25h (15-29). Dichotomized at <=24h vs >24h.

outcomes.outcome_definition: All-cause mortality at 6 weeks after onset of candidemia
outcomes.notes: Table 3: TTP <=24h: survivors 19/63 (30.2%), died 15/37 (40.5%), chi-square p=0.3. Calculated events: 15 deaths in short-TTP group (n=34), 22 deaths in long-TTP group (n=66; total 37 deaths). Kaplan-Meier log-rank test showed no difference in survival between TTP<24h and TTP>24h. Overall mortality 37/100 (37%).

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Mycobacterial BSI (HIV-TB) - not traditional bacteremia. TTP converted to 4-level ordinal scale (negative + 3 tertiles); not analyzed in hours directly. AUC for day-28 mortality with BC TTP ordinal scale was 0.60 vs latent variable theta 0.67. Khayelitsha, Cape Town. Funding: Wellcome Trust, NIH, MRC South Africa.

population.incubation_protocol: Mycobacterial blood culture; details in original cohort publication
population.notes: HIV-positive adults (CD4<350) admitted to hospital with new HIV-associated TB diagnosis. 519 participants with microbiologically confirmed TB. Brief report; demographics in Supplementary Table 2 (not extracted from text).

ttp.notes: TTP converted to 4-level ordinal scale: 0 = negative; semi-quantitative readouts divided into tertiles, 1 (highest Ct/TTP) to 3 (lowest Ct/TTP). Specific TTP hours not reported in text. Histograms shown but no median/IQR in text.

outcomes.notes: Logistic regression of TTP ordinal scale to day-28 mortality: AUC 0.60 (bootstrapped ROC AUC). Comparator measures: theta latent variable AUC 0.67, sputum-Xpert Ct AUC 0.55, sum score AUC 0.62, ordinal score AUC 0.63. No OR/CI reported for TTP. Event counts not reported in text.

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Letter-to-editor brief report. Multivariable analysis included antibiotic therapy, co-morbidity (Charlson). Excluded MRSA, central catheter draws, prior antibiotics. Community-acquired MSSA only. Nambour Hospital 350 beds.

population.empiric_abx_definition: Initiation of adequate antibiotic therapy within 24 hours
population.incubation_protocol: BacT/Alert automated continuous-monitoring blood culture system (Organon Teknika)
population.notes: Age range 17-94 years. Charlson score <=2 in 58.9%; >=5 in 18 subjects. Endocarditis in 15 (10.3%); respiratory focus 14 (9.6%); unknown focus 44 (30.1%).

ttp.notes: Mean TTP 17.29h (range 8-88h). Dichotomized at <12h vs >=12h. n in each TTP group not reported.

outcomes.adjustment_vars: antibiotic therapy (adequate within 24h); Charlson comorbidity index
outcomes.notes: Multivariate logistic regression. TTP <12h: adjusted OR 5.91 (95% CI 1.80-19.44), p=0.003. Overall 30-day mortality 34/146 (23.3%). Stratified event counts by TTP not reported. Other significant predictors: antibiotic therapy OR 0.03 (p<0.001), co-morbidity OR 3.99 (p=0.002).

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Primary outcome is infective endocarditis (not mortality). Large cohort (n=1703). Multivariable analysis adjusted for pacemaker/ICD, prosthetic valve, vascular graft, IV drug use, hemodialysis, place of acquisition, and TTP <13h. TTP measurement bias possible: pre-Dec 2018 blood cultures were transported before incubation (vs. immediate incubation after Dec 2018) - flagged as prognostic measurement concern. Danderyd Hospital tertiary 500-bed.

population.incubation_protocol: BacT/ALERT 3D (2011-2018) then BacT/ALERT Virtuo (from Dec 2018). Pre-2018 cultures transported before incubation; post-2018 immediate incubation at Danderyd
population.notes: 1703 episodes in 1610 patients. Charlson median 2 (IQR 1-3). 29.5% community-acquired, 41% healthcare-associated, 29.5% hospital-acquired. Endocarditis 154/1703 (9%). 30-day mortality 406/1703 (24%). Echocardiography performed in 65%.

ttp.notes: Overall median TTP 13h (IQR 9.8-17.5; range 2-110.2). With endocarditis: median 9h (IQR 7-12); without: 13h (IQR 10-18), p<0.001. Median split: TTP<13h n=844 (events 120+724); TTP>=13h n=858 (events 34+824). Youden index 11.85h. 1 case missing TTP (n=1702 for stratified analyses).

outcomes.notes: Mortality reported as overall 30-day mortality 406/1703 (24%) and 96h mortality 146/1703 (9%). No TTP-stratified mortality analysis reported (primary outcome was endocarditis). Mortality 30d by site of acquisition: community 16%, healthcare-associated 27%, hospital-acquired 28%.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Endocarditis (modified Duke criteria) - PRIMARY outcome of paper, but reported as a complication of bacteremia
outcomes.adjustment_vars: pacemaker/ICD; prosthetic heart valve; vascular graft; IV drug use; hemodialysis; place of acquisition
outcomes.notes: Primary outcome of paper is infective endocarditis (mapped to persistent_bacteremia per available enum since 'endocarditis' isn't an option in outcome_type enum; flagged in notes). TTP<13h vs >=13h: adjusted OR 3.59 (95% CI 2.35-5.3), p<0.001. Per-hour OR 0.89 (95% CI 0.54-0.92) (continuous, univariate). Univariate TTP<13h OR 4.02 (2.71-5.96). NPV of TTP>13h = 96% (95% CI 95-97). AUC 0.72 (0.67-0.76).

study.notes: Extractor: Cowork agent. Date: 2026-05-25. Population-based retrospective study covering Region Skåne (population ~1.4M). Multi-hospital but single microbiology lab. TTP analysis univariate only (Mann-Whitney U); no multivariable model. Patients from hospitals without on-site incubators excluded from TTP analysis (n=52). Funding: Royal Physiographic Society of Lund, ALF (governmental clinical research). Streptococcus agalactiae bacteraemia.

population.incubation_protocol: BACTEC FX system (Becton Dickinson). Five largest hospitals had on-site incubators; smaller hospitals (n=52 patients) sent bottles to central lab (excluded from TTP analysis)
population.notes: Most common focus: skin/soft tissue 169 (37%), unknown 155 (33%), skeletal/joint 48 (10%), genitourinary 36 (8%), respiratory 32 (7%), IE 23 (5%). Charlson median 1 (IQR 0-2). 30-day mortality 40/463 (9%); 90-day 53/463 (11%). TTP analysis subset: n=411 (excluding 52 from hospitals without incubators).

ttp.notes: TTP analyzed continuously, n=411 (52 patients from hospitals without on-site incubators excluded). Overall median TTP 8.8h (IQR 7.5-10.2). Hospitals with incubators (n=359): TTP 9.1h (7.7-10.4). Hospitals without (n=52): TTP 6.6h (3.9-8.3), p<0.0001 - TTP shorter due to pre-analytical delay before incubation. TTP analysis subset was hospitals with incubators only.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 30-day all-cause mortality from blood culture obtainment
outcomes.notes: TTP analyzed continuously by Mann-Whitney U. Non-survivors (30-day, n=40): TTP median 8.6h (IQR 7.6-10.1). Survivors: 9.1h (IQR 7.8-10.4), p=0.4. Overall 30-day mortality 40/463 (9%). Only analyzed in n=411 subset.

outcomes.outcome_definition: 90-day all-cause mortality from blood culture obtainment
outcomes.notes: 90-day mortality: TTP 8.8h (IQR 7.6-10.1) in non-survivors (n=51) vs 9.1h (IQR 7.8-10.4) in survivors (n=359), p=0.4.

outcomes.outcome_definition: Infective endocarditis (Duke-ISCVID criteria) - reported as a secondary outcome
outcomes.notes: IE outcome mapped to persistent_bacteremia per available enum (no 'endocarditis' option). IE patients (n=18 in TTP analysis subset; n=23 overall): TTP median 7.5h (IQR 5.9-8.8). Non-IE (n=393): 9.1h (IQR 7.9-10.5). Mann-Whitney U p=0.005. No OR/multivariable analysis reported.
